//: Deploys apps/web only. The API, the render worker and the Python
inference service cannot run here — they need persistent processes,
ffmpeg, a GPU and long-lived WebSockets. Point NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL at
wherever those are hosted. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md#vercel.
Leave the project's Root Directory as the repository root: the web app
imports @lipsync/shared through the npm workspace, which only resolves
buildCommand: npm run build --workspace @lipsync/shared && npm run build --workspace @lipsync/web
